question: Who among the following was the runner-up defeated by Viktor Axelsen in his third India Open victory in the 2025 India Open Badminton Tournament in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lee Cheuk Yiu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Viktor Axelsen secured his third India Open title in January 2025 by defeating **Lee Cheuk Yiu** in the final.
 
• The India Open is a **prestigious Super 750 Badminton World Federation (BWF) tournament** held annually in India.
 
• Lee Cheuk Yiu is a prominent badminton player from **Hong Kong**, known for his exceptional agility and tactical gameplay.
 
• Viktor Axelsen, the reigning world champion and Olympic gold medalist, showcased dominant form throughout the tournament.
 
• Axelsen's win at the India Open 2025 further solidified his position as one of the greatest badminton players of his era.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Viktor Axelsen**

 
 
• He is a Danish badminton player and one of the most dominant figures in the sport.
 
• Axelsen won the **2020 Olympic gold medal** in men's singles and several world championships.
 
• His playing style combines strong offensive techniques with excellent court coverage and consistency.
 
• He has been ranked as the **world number one in men's singles** multiple times by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
 
 
• **India Open Badminton Tournament**
 
 
• It is part of the HSBC BWF World Tour and classified as a Super 750 event.
 
• The tournament attracts top badminton players from around the globe.
 
• It was first held in 2008 and has since become a key event in the badminton calendar.
 
• Winners of the India Open earn crucial points toward their BWF world rankings.
 
 
 
• **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**
 
 
• BWF is the international governing body for the sport of badminton, founded in 1934.
 
• It oversees major tournaments like the World Championships, Thomas and Uber Cups, and the BWF World Tour.
 
• The BWF headquarters is located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
 
 
• **Lee Cheuk Yiu**
 
 
• Lee Cheuk Yiu is a professional badminton player from Hong Kong who has competed in several major tournaments.
 
• He is known for his **impressive speed and shot precision**.
 
• Lee has won significant matches in international tournaments, showcasing his skills on the global stage.
